routerDesc: Picks which agent and which model should answer a request.
researcherDesc: Answers questions from the workspace, read-only, with citations.
author: Author
authorDesc: Creates pages and opens merge requests on existing ones.
reviewerDesc: Reviews a draft and reports issues with severities.
drafterDesc: Writes or rewrites one page of markdown from an instruction.
plannerDesc: Breaks a page into the list of pages that should follow it.
extractorDesc: Infers graph relations from a page. Emits stable keys, never translated.
glossaristDesc: Proposes glossary terms grounded in occurrences on the page.
transcriberDesc: Transcribes a scanned page image to markdown. Never summarises.
curatorDesc: Scans the workspace for stale, orphaned and duplicated pages.
architectDesc: Turns a description of a chain into a workflow definition to review.
cartographerDesc: Proposes the relations a page should declare, grounded in what it says.
archaeologistDesc: Reads a connected repository and drafts pages for the business logic no document declares.
sentinelDesc: Checks the pages a pull or merge request may make wrong, and drafts the corrections.
surveyorDesc: Clusters the questions answers failed on into coverage gaps, and proposes the page that would close each.
digestDesc: Summarises what changed since the last digest — new and changed pages, merged changes — as a page you can publish.
linterDesc: Checks text against the styleguide your team wrote — only its rules, each violation quoted from the text.
auditorDesc: Scores every page on clarity, completeness, links, ownership, near-duplicates and style, and reports the worst ones.

route.wrongSurface: does not run on the {surface} surface
route.noCandidate: No agent passed the capability gate.
route.onlyCandidate: The only agent able to run this.

curation.noPages: This workspace has no pages yet.
curation.orphanDetail: This page declares no relations and nothing references it, so it will not surface through the graph — only through search. Adding a relation in its frontmatter puts it back on the map.

cartography.noPages: This workspace has no pages yet.
cartography.unconfirmedTitle: "{title}" has {count} inferred connection(s) nobody has confirmed
cartography.unconfirmedDetail: A model read these connections out of the text, but the page does not declare them. An inferred edge is the lowest-trust class there is and is replaced on every re-index; declaring it in the page's frontmatter makes it a fact the page itself asserts. Proposed: {list}.
cartography.graphUnavailable: The relation graph could not be read, so only the model's suggestions are included.
cartography.summary: Looked at {pages} pages and proposes relations for {found} of them.

review.cannotRun: The model routed at the reviewer cannot run it.
review.noPages: No indexed pages to review yet.
review.none: No page could be reviewed in this pass.

glossary.disabled: The AI assistant is disabled for this workspace.
glossary.budgetSpent: Stopped after {pages}: the workspace AI budget is spent.
glossary.nothingNew: Scanned {pages}; every term they use is already defined.
glossary.allScanned: Every page has been scanned at its current version; nothing new to read.

archaeology.noModel: No model is configured for the archaeologist, so the repository was inventoried and nothing was read.
archaeology.digestSkipped: The declared-knowledge digest could not be written, so the raw document headings were used instead.
archaeology.noCandidates: Read {docs} documents and {pages} pages for "{repository}"; every source file that decides something is already covered.
archaeology.budgetSpent: Stopped after {files} of {candidates} files: the workspace AI budget is spent.
archaeology.summary: Read {docs} documents and {pages} pages for "{repository}", then {files} source files nothing declares; proposes {findings} new pages.

component.noModel: No model is configured for the archaeologist, so the component could not be documented.
component.pathsMissing: {paths} is not in "{repository}" at its current head, so there is nothing to document.
component.draftUnusable: The model's page left out a section of the component template, so it was not kept. Run it again, or write the page from the template.
component.findingDetail: A component page drafted from {paths}. It opens as a merge request; nothing is published until it merges.
component.summary: Drafted a component page for {name} from {files} files of "{repository}".

drift.truncated: The change touches more files than are read in one check; only the first {files} were considered.
drift.noFiles: Change #{number} touches nothing this connector reads.
drift.noRelated: Change #{number} touches {files} files, and no page is tied to any of them.
drift.noModel: No model is configured for the sentinel, so the pages tied to the change are listed without a verdict.
drift.mayDriftDetail: Change #{number} touches files this page is tied to: {files}.
drift.summaryNoModel: Change #{number}: {pages} pages are tied to the changed files; none was read.
drift.budgetSpent: Stopped after {checked} of {pages} pages: the workspace AI budget is spent.
drift.searchFailed: Searching for pages about the change failed, so only linked and naming pages were checked.

comment.heading: Documentation drift check
comment.clean: No page in {connector} drifts from this change as of {sha}.
comment.intro: As of {sha}, {count} page(s) in {connector} may need updating after this change:
comment.footer: Updated on every push. Pages are only changed through the merge requests linked above.
comment.usagesIntro: Code that uses the components this change touches, by the page that documents it:
comment.apiNoRoutes: routes not compared: no supported framework found
comment.apiAgrees: no new disagreement with the code

paths.title: "{title}" declares paths this change removes or moves
paths.moved: Change #{number} removes or moves files this page declares in component.paths: {moves}.
paths.gone: Change #{number} removes every path this page declares ({paths}), so the code it documents is gone.

drift.overlayFailed: The change's own files could not be read, so usages are counted from the configured branch only.
drift.overlayPartial: {files} changed files could not be read at the head of the change; their usages are counted from the configured branch.
drift.usagesFailed: Finding the code that uses the changed components failed, so only the pages tied to the changed files were checked.

api.missingInCode: {op} is in the spec, but no route serves it
api.missingInSpec: {op} is served by the code, but no spec documents it
api.methodMismatch: {op} is in the spec, but the code serves {code} on that path
api.findingTitle: "{title}" disagrees with the code on {count} path(s)
api.findingDetailPr: Change #{number} leaves the spec and the routes disagreeing: {list}.
api.findingDetail: {path} and the routes in the repository disagree: {list}.
api.headPartial: {files} changed files were not read at the head of the change; their routes are counted from the configured branch.
api.headUnread: {path} could not be read at the head of the change; its routes are counted from the configured branch.
api.specGone: The spec file {path} is no longer in the repository, so it was not compared.
api.specUnparsed: The spec file {path} did not parse, so it was not compared: {error}
api.failed: Comparing the API specs with the routes in the code failed, so only the pages tied to the changed files were checked.
api.hidden: {count} restricted spec(s) were compared but are not listed.
api.summaryPr: Change #{number} ties {specs} spec(s); {drifted} disagree with the code.
api.needsSpec: An API drift check needs a spec document and the repository it is synced from.
api.restricted: The spec is restricted to some members. An agent run is listed to the whole workspace, so it is not compared here.
api.summaryUnchecked: The spec was not compared: it is not in the repository, or it did not parse.
api.summaryNoRoutes: "{title}" was not compared: no route of a supported framework (NestJS, Express, Fastify, FastAPI, Go) was found in the repository.
api.summaryDrifted: "{title}" disagrees with the code on {count} path(s); {routes} routes were read.
api.summaryClean: "{title}" matches the code: {routes} routes were read, and none disagrees.

report.noContent: "{title}" has no readable content to judge the report against.
report.restricted: The reported page is restricted to some members. An agent run is listed to the whole workspace, so none judges it — a person with access should review the report.
report.noModel: No model is configured for the sentinel, so the report is passed on without a verdict.
report.summaryNoModel: Report on "{title}" was not judged; it stays open for a person.
report.summaryConfirmed: Report on "{title}" confirmed; corrected pages drafted: {drafted}.
report.summaryRejected: Report on "{title}" checked: the page holds up.

coverage.noEmbedding: The surveyor needs a real embedding provider to cluster questions; EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=stub would produce junk clusters, so nothing was read.
coverage.noSignals: No down-voted, low-confidence or unanswered questions in the last {days} days.
coverage.tooFew: Read {signals} signals ({questions} distinct questions) and found no topic asked {min} or more times.
coverage.noModel: No model is configured for the surveyor, so the clusters are listed without a recommendation.
coverage.noModelDetail: {count} answers about this failed. The knowledge base was not searched for what covers it; a person decides what to write.
coverage.summaryNoModel: Read {signals} signals and found {clusters} topics; none was judged.
coverage.budgetSpent: Stopped after {judged} of {clusters} topics: the workspace AI budget is spent.
coverage.summary: Read {signals} signals ({questions} distinct questions), found {clusters} topics and judged {judged}; proposes {findings} gaps.

warning.graphUnreadableOrphans: The relation graph could not be read, so the orphan check was skipped.
warning.graphUnreadableModelOnly: The relation graph could not be read, so only the model half ran.
warning.modelPassFailedStructuralOnly: The model pass failed, so only structural findings are included.
warning.stopped: Stopped early, the remaining items were not checked: {error}

digestRun.quiet: Nothing changed in the last {days} days: no new or changed pages, no merged changes, no findings.
digestRun.summary: In the last {days} days: {created} new pages, {changed} changed, {merged} changes merged.
digestRun.draftDetail: The digest as a page: {created} new, {changed} changed, {merged} merged. Create page publishes it as you.

recipe.freshnessSweepNote: Focus on freshness: report pages that look stale against the rest of the workspace or against the source they were imported from, as kind "stale", and say what has moved on.
recipe.glossarySuggesterNote: Propose glossary terms only from the page that was just merged.

lint.noInput: This linter run names no merge request check.
lint.cannotRun: The linter cannot run: no AI provider is configured for it, or its model lacks JSON output.
lint.notVisible: The merge request is gone, or its page is not open to every member.
lint.noStyleguide: No styleguide applies to this page.
lint.nothingChanged: The merge request adds nothing to lint.

dropped.one: The linter reported {count} violation that does not quote the page; it was dropped.
dropped.other: The linter reported {count} violations that do not quote the page; they were dropped.

quality.modelOff: No model is configured for the auditor: clarity, completeness and style are not scored, only links, ownership and duplicates.
quality.noEmbeddings: Could not read page embeddings: near-duplicates were not checked.
quality.stubEmbeddings: Embeddings are the stub provider, which cannot tell near-duplicates apart: duplication was not measured.
quality.brokenIdLink: The link "{text}" points at a page that does not exist.
quality.brokenTitleLink: The reference "{text}" names "{title}", which matches no single page.
quality.duplicateDetail: Their content is {similarity}% similar. Merge them, or make each say what the other does not.
quality.lowDetail: The page scores below the quality threshold.
quality.summary: Scored {pages}, averaging {average}/100: {calls} judged by the model, {reused} unchanged since their last score.

arbiterDesc: Finds passages in two pages that contradict each other and records them as conflicts to resolve.

arbitration.stubEmbeddings: The stub embedding provider cannot tell which passages are about the same thing; no pages were compared.
arbitration.nothingChanged: No page changed since the last check.
arbitration.noPairs: No passages were close enough to compare.
arbitration.budgetSpent: The AI budget ran out after {judged} comparisons.
arbitration.summary: Compared {judged} pairs of passages; {found} new contradictions.

atlasDesc: Groups related pages into communities and summarises each, so broad questions can be answered across the whole knowledge base.

charting.disabled: Community summaries are off on this server (COMMUNITY_SUMMARIES_ENABLED).
charting.unchanged: The graph has not changed since the last summaries; nothing rebuilt.
charting.noCommunities: No group of related pages was large enough to summarise.
charting.budgetSpent: The AI budget ran out after {done} summaries; the next run finishes the rest.
